en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a large, ornate historic building with a steeply pitched roof, elaborate timber framing, decorative windows, balconies, and a tower-like structure on the right. The building is surrounded by lush gardens and trees. The upper left corner of the postcard contains the text 'Bad Pyrmont Christliches Hospiz.' The reverse side has typical postcard formatting with designated spaces for a message, address, and stamp, as well as text related to a publisher and museum.
